# Bundled Markdown renderer

`markdown-it.min.js` is the browser UMD build from [markdown-it 15.0.3](https://www.npmjs.com/package/markdown-it/v/15.0.3), at `dist/browser/markdown-it.umd.min.js` in the npm archive. Only its source-map comment was removed. See [the upstream MIT licence](markdown-it.LICENSE). The application serves it locally; no CDN or frontend build is required.
